name: proxy-url-app

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:api && npm run test:e2e:ui
scripts.deploy: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run build
scripts.redeploy: npm run pm2:stop && npm run deploy && pm2 startOrRestart ecosystem.config.js

//allowScripts: npm 11 blocks dependency install scripts until they are approved here; bcrypt and canvas need theirs to resolve their native bindings. Write entries with `npm install-scripts approve <pkg>` rather than by hand -- the key must carry the version (`pkg@1.2.3`), and a plain `pkg: version` entry is silently ignored. Pinning means a version bump re-prompts instead of inheriting approval. tesseract.js is denied: its postinstall is only an Open Collective funding message.
//optionalDependencies: The lockfile is generated on macOS, so it only carries darwin-arm64 native binaries and the Windows deploy box cannot resolve its own. Listing the win32 variants here forces them into the lockfile; npm skips them on macOS because each declares os/cpu. Keep the versions in step with rollup/esbuild/@napi-rs/canvas.
